text: If you can't stop obsessing about someone, if you can't stop ruminating about them,
ipa: /ˈɪf jˈu kˈænt stˈɑp əbsˈɛsɪŋ əbˈaʊt sˈʌmwˌʌn ˈɪf jˈu kˈænt stˈɑp ruminating əbˈaʊt ðˈɛm/

text: if you're waiting by the phone, waiting for their text
ipa: /ˈɪf jˈʊɹ wˈeɪtɪŋ bˈaɪ ðə fˈoʊn wˈeɪtɪŋ fˈɔɹ ðˈɛɹ tˈɛkst/
vi: nếu bạn đang đợi điện thoại, đợi tin nhắn của họ

text: or their call, maybe this is someone you've been seeing
ipa: /ˈɔɹ ðˈɛɹ kˈɔl mˈeɪbi ðˈɪs ˈɪz sˈʌmwˌʌn jˈuv bˈɪn sˈiɪŋ/

text: who isn't investing in you at the level that you've been investing in them.
ipa: /hˈu ˈɪzənt ˌɪnvˈɛstɪŋ ɪn jˈu ˈæt ðə lˈɛvəl ðˈæt jˈuv bˈɪn ˌɪnvˈɛstɪŋ ɪn ðˈɛm/

text: Maybe this is someone who keeps walking in and out of your life
ipa: /mˈeɪbi ðˈɪs ˈɪz sˈʌmwˌʌn hˈu kˈips wˈɔkɪŋ ɪn ənd ˈaʊt ˈʌv jˈɔɹ lˈaɪf/
vi: Có lẽ đây là người cứ bước vào rồi lại bước ra khỏi cuộc đời bạn

text: and you keep going back to them against your better judgment.
ipa: /ənd jˈu kˈip ɡˈoʊɪŋ bˈæk tˈu ðˈɛm əɡˈɛnst jˈɔɹ bˈɛtɚ dʒˈʌdʒmənt/
vi: và bạn cứ quay lại với họ bất chấp phán đoán tốt nhất của mình.

text: I want you to know that this is really not about them.
ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɑnt jˈu tˈu nˈoʊ ðˈæt ðˈɪs ˈɪz ɹˈɪli nˈɑt əbˈaʊt ðˈɛm/

text: It's not that you like them so much.
ipa: /ˈɪts nˈɑt ðˈæt jˈu lˈaɪk ðˈɛm sˈoʊ mˈʌtʃ/

text: It's that maybe there is something inside of you that feels missing.
ipa: /ˈɪts ðˈæt mˈeɪbi ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz sˈʌmθɪŋ ˌɪnsˈaɪd ˈʌv jˈu ðˈæt fˈilz mˈɪsɪŋ/

text: Maybe it's that life is not preoccupying you enough, and this is not a judgment.
ipa: /mˈeɪbi ˈɪts ðˈæt lˈaɪf ˈɪz nˈɑt preoccupying jˈu ɪnˈʌf ənd ðˈɪs ˈɪz nˈɑt ə dʒˈʌdʒmənt/

text: I have been where you are.
ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈæv bˈɪn wˈɛɹ jˈu ˈɑɹ/

text: But consider that they are just a metaphor for novelty,

ipa: /fˈɔɹ ɪksˈaɪtmənt fˈɔɹ ædvˈɛntʃɚ ənd ðˈæt ðˈoʊz ˈɑɹ ðə θˈɪŋz/

text: This isn't about them.
ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪzənt əbˈaʊt ðˈɛm/
vi: Việc này không liên quan đến họ.

text: This is about your relationship with yourself and the life that you know you must lead.
ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz əbˈaʊt jˈɔɹ ɹilˈeɪʃənʃˌɪp wˈɪð jɚsˈɛlf ənd ðə lˈaɪf ðˈæt jˈu nˈoʊ jˈu mˈʌst lˈɛd/

text: I worked with someone a long time ago who couldn't get this person
ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɝkt wˈɪð sˈʌmwˌʌn ə lˈɔŋ tˈaɪm əɡˈoʊ hˈu kˈʊdənt ɡˈɛt ðˈɪs pˈɝsən/

text: that she was seeing out of her head.

text: She was dating him on and off for about 9 10 months.

ipa: /ənd ˈɪf ˈaɪm ˈɑnəst ˈɪt wˈɑz pɹˈɑbəblˌi ə kˌɑmbənˈeɪʃən ˈʌv ðə tˈu/

ipa: /ənd ʃˈi ˈɔlsoʊ tˈɑlɚˌeɪtɪd wˈɛl bɪlˈoʊ hˈɝ stˈændɚd fˈɔɹ hɚsˈɛlf/

ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ʃˈi stˈɑɹtɪd ˈæktɪŋ ɪn wˈeɪz ðˈæt wˈɝ ənɹˌɛkəɡnˈaɪzəbəl tˈu hɚsˈɛlf/

ipa: /ənd sˈoʊ ʃˈi wˈʊd bɹˈeɪk ˈʌp wˈɪð hˈɪm/

text: In moments of strength she would finally end

ipa: /ˈɪt bɪkˈɔz hˈi wˈʊd dˈu sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt wˈʊd dʒˈʌst bˈi ðə fˈaɪnəl stɹˈɔ sˈʌmθɪŋ ɹˈɪli dˌɪsɹɪspˈɛktfəl/

text: And then, after like a few weeks, not even a month,
ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn ˈæftɚ lˈaɪk ə fjˈu wˈiks nˈɑt ˈivɪn ə mˈʌnθ/

text: He would come back into her life, and instead of holding
ipa: /hˈi wˈʊd kˈʌm bˈæk ˈɪntu hˈɝ lˈaɪf ənd ˌɪnstˈɛd ˈʌv hˈoʊldɪŋ/

ipa: /ʃˈi dʒˈʌst kˈɛpt lˈɛtɪŋ hˈɪm ɪn/

text: And he whether he was actively in her life or the times
ipa: /ənd hˈi wˈɛðɚ hˈi wˈɑz ˈæktɪvli ɪn hˈɝ lˈaɪf ˈɔɹ ðə tˈaɪmz/

ipa: /wˈɛn ʃˈi bɹˈoʊk ˈʌp wˈɪð hˈɪm hˈi tˈʊk ˈʌp ˈɔl hˈɝ mˈɛntəl ɹˈil ɪstˈeɪt/

ipa: /ənd ʃˈi hˈæd ðˈɪs bɪlˈif ðˈæt ˈɪts bɪkˈɔz ðˈæt lˈaɪk ˈivɪn/

text: though things were hard, she just had such a strong connection with him.
ipa: /ðˈoʊ θˈɪŋz wˈɝ hˈɑɹd ʃˈi dʒˈʌst hˈæd sˈʌtʃ ə stɹˈɔŋ kənˈɛkʃən wˈɪð hˈɪm/

text: And this is something that I hear all the time, but that connection.
ipa: /ənd ðˈɪs ˈɪz sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæt ˈaɪ hˈiɹ ˈɔl ðə tˈaɪm bˈʌt ðˈæt kənˈɛkʃən/

ipa: /ənd ðˈæts ðˈɪs wˈɛn ʃˈi ɹˈiəlˌaɪzd ðˈæt ˈɛvɚi tˈaɪm ʃˈi wˈɑz ɡˈoʊɪŋ bˈæk tˈu hˈɪm/

ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɑz ˈɔlwˌeɪz wˈɛn ʃˈi wˈɑz fˈilɪŋ vˈɛɹi dˈaʊn/

text: She was having like little mini existential crises where she didn't know
ipa: /ʃˈi wˈɑz hˈævɪŋ lˈaɪk lˈɪtəl mˈɪni ˌɛɡzˌɪstˈɛnʃəl kɹˈaɪsiz wˈɛɹ ʃˈi dˈɪdənt nˈoʊ/

text: She was living in a different state than her family.
ipa: /ʃˈi wˈɑz lˈɪvɪŋ ɪn ə dˈɪfɚənt stˈeɪt ðˈæn hˈɝ fˈæməli/

ipa: /ʃˈi hˈæd fɹˈɛndz bˈʌt ʃˈi dˈɪdənt hˈæv lˈaɪk stɹˈʌktʃɚ tˈu hˈɝ dˈeɪ/

text: And her work, like I said, was very uncertain.
ipa: /ənd hˈɝ wˈɝk lˈaɪk ˈaɪ sˈɛd wˈɑz vˈɛɹi ənsˈɝtən/

text: And she was feeling that thing that we often feel

ipa: /ənd hˈi wˈɑz ˈæt lˈist fəmˈɪljɚ/

text: And he could give her that kind of connect, that that connection,
ipa: /ənd hˈi kˈʊd ɡˈɪv hˈɝ ðˈæt kˈaɪnd ˈʌv kənˈɛkt ðˈæt ðˈæt kənˈɛkʃən/

text: the cuddling, the hug, the kiss, the sleeping together.
ipa: /ðə kˈʌdlɪŋ ðə hˈʌɡ ðə kˈɪs ðə slˈipɪŋ təɡˈɛðɚ/

text: Unconsciously she would run back to him to scratch this itch
ipa: /ˌʌnkˈɑnʃəsli ʃˈi wˈʊd ɹˈʌn bˈæk tˈu hˈɪm tˈu skɹˈætʃ ðˈɪs ˈɪtʃ/

text: that she didn't know how to scratch for herself,
ipa: /ðˈæt ʃˈi dˈɪdənt nˈoʊ hˈaʊ tˈu skɹˈætʃ fˈɔɹ hɚsˈɛlf/

text: which was feeling totally disconnected from her life.
ipa: /wˈɪtʃ wˈɑz fˈilɪŋ tˈoʊtəli dˌɪskənˈɛktɪd fɹˈʌm hˈɝ lˈaɪf/

text: And so he was just a metaphor for what felt missing in her life.
ipa: /ənd sˈoʊ hˈi wˈɑz dʒˈʌst ə mˈɛtəfɔɹ fˈɔɹ wˈʌt fˈɛlt mˈɪsɪŋ ɪn hˈɝ lˈaɪf/

text: He was also just a distraction from her having to deal with her life
ipa: /hˈi wˈɑz ˈɔlsoʊ dʒˈʌst ə dɪstɹˈækʃən fɹˈʌm hˈɝ hˈævɪŋ tˈu dˈil wˈɪð hˈɝ lˈaɪf/

text: and creating the life that she wanted to live.
ipa: /ənd kɹiˈeɪtɪŋ ðə lˈaɪf ðˈæt ʃˈi wˈɔntɪd tˈu lˈaɪv/

text: And so she recognized that she had to choose herself,
ipa: /ənd sˈoʊ ʃˈi ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪzd ðˈæt ʃˈi hˈæd tˈu tʃˈuz hɚsˈɛlf/

text: which had nothing to do with villainizing him, which, by the way,
ipa: /wˈɪtʃ hˈæd nˈʌθɪŋ tˈu dˈu wˈɪð villainizing hˈɪm wˈɪtʃ bˈaɪ ðə wˈeɪ/

text: we could have villainized him because he just wasn't a great guy.
ipa: /wˈi kˈʊd hˈæv villainized hˈɪm bɪkˈɔz hˈi dʒˈʌst wˈɑzənt ə ɡɹˈeɪt ɡˈaɪ/

text: But she had to take full responsibility and recognize
ipa: /bˈʌt ʃˈi hˈæd tˈu tˈeɪk fˈʊl ɹispˌɑnsəbˈɪləti ənd ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪz/

text: that if she's going to live the life that she wants to live
ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪf ʃˈiz ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu lˈaɪv ðə lˈaɪf ðˈæt ʃˈi wˈɑnts tˈu lˈaɪv/

text: and have the kind of love that she wants in her life,
ipa: /ənd hˈæv ðə kˈaɪnd ˈʌv lˈʌv ðˈæt ʃˈi wˈɑnts ɪn hˈɝ lˈaɪf/

text: she could not do that while she was with this person and taking him back.
ipa: /ʃˈi kˈʊd nˈɑt dˈu ðˈæt wˈaɪl ʃˈi wˈɑz wˈɪð ðˈɪs pˈɝsən ənd tˈeɪkɪŋ hˈɪm bˈæk/

text: And also she could never find the true love that she wanted
ipa: /ənd ˈɔlsoʊ ʃˈi kˈʊd nˈɛvɚ fˈaɪnd ðə tɹˈu lˈʌv ðˈæt ʃˈi wˈɔntɪd/

text: and the healthy relationship that she needed without first addressing this in her life.
ipa: /ənd ðə hˈɛlθi ɹilˈeɪʃənʃˌɪp ðˈæt ʃˈi nˈidəd wɪθˈaʊt fˈɝst ədɹˈɛsɪŋ ðˈɪs ɪn hˈɝ lˈaɪf/

text: Because until she did that, everyone
ipa: /bɪkˈɔz əntˈɪl ʃˈi dˈɪd ðˈæt ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn/

text: who would come into her life would just be sort of like that distraction.
ipa: /hˈu wˈʊd kˈʌm ˈɪntu hˈɝ lˈaɪf wˈʊd dʒˈʌst bˈi sˈɔɹt ˈʌv lˈaɪk ðˈæt dɪstɹˈækʃən/

text: You do not have to have your life all figured out.
ipa: /jˈu dˈu nˈɑt hˈæv tˈu hˈæv jˈɔɹ lˈaɪf ˈɔl fˈɪɡjɚd ˈaʊt/

text: We go through, we go through phases where we feel very plugged
ipa: /wˈi ɡˈoʊ θɹˈu wˈi ɡˈoʊ θɹˈu fˈeɪzəz wˈɛɹ wˈi fˈil vˈɛɹi plˈʌɡd/

text: in and connected to ourselves and connected to our center
ipa: /ɪn ənd kənˈɛktɪd tˈu aʊɚsˈɛlvz ənd kənˈɛktɪd tˈu ˈaʊɚ sˈɛntɚ/

text: and connected to family and work and our health.
ipa: /ənd kənˈɛktɪd tˈu fˈæməli ənd wˈɝk ənd ˈaʊɚ hˈɛlθ/

text: And then we go through different dips and valleys where we feel disconnected,
ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn wˈi ɡˈoʊ θɹˈu dˈɪfɚənt dˈɪps ənd vˈæliz wˈɛɹ wˈi fˈil dˌɪskənˈɛktɪd/

text: or we wonder, like, what our purpose
ipa: /ˈɔɹ wˈi wˈʌndɚ lˈaɪk wˈʌt ˈaʊɚ pˈɝpəs/

text: is, or we're not feeling in flow with our life.
ipa: /ˈɪz ˈɔɹ wˈiɹ nˈɑt fˈilɪŋ ɪn flˈoʊ wˈɪð ˈaʊɚ lˈaɪf/

text: So it's not about being perfect and having it set all the time,
ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪts nˈɑt əbˈaʊt bˈiɪŋ pɚfˈɛkt ənd hˈævɪŋ ˈɪt sˈɛt ˈɔl ðə tˈaɪm/

text: but it is about understanding that when you're obsessing over someone
ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɪt ˈɪz əbˈaʊt ˌʌndɚstˈændɪŋ ðˈæt wˈɛn jˈʊɹ əbsˈɛsɪŋ ˈoʊvɚ sˈʌmwˌʌn/

text: who you don't actually know that well, or someone
ipa: /hˈu jˈu dˈoʊnt ˈæktʃˌuəli nˈoʊ ðˈæt wˈɛl ˈɔɹ sˈʌmwˌʌn/

text: who has never really committed
ipa: /hˈu hˈæz nˈɛvɚ ɹˈɪli kəmˈɪtɪd/

text: to you and you've never really been committed to each other,
ipa: /tˈu jˈu ənd jˈuv nˈɛvɚ ɹˈɪli bˈɪn kəmˈɪtɪd tˈu ˈitʃ ˈʌðɚ/

text: or someone who is proven to be completely unavailable in every way
ipa: /ˈɔɹ sˈʌmwˌʌn hˈu ˈɪz pɹˈuvən tˈu bˈi kəmplˈitli ˌʌnəvˈeɪləbəl ɪn ˈɛvɚi wˈeɪ/

text: and really just brings out even the worst
ipa: /ənd ɹˈɪli dʒˈʌst bɹˈɪŋz ˈaʊt ˈivɪn ðə wˈɝst/

text: in you, we think that it's because this person is so special.
ipa: /ɪn jˈu wˈi θˈɪŋk ðˈæt ˈɪts bɪkˈɔz ðˈɪs pˈɝsən ˈɪz sˈoʊ spˈɛʃəl/

text: We think we want them.
ipa: /wˈi θˈɪŋk wˈi wˈɑnt ðˈɛm/

text: We think we need them, when the reality
ipa: /wˈi θˈɪŋk wˈi nˈid ðˈɛm wˈɛn ðə ɹˌiˈælətˌi/

text: is is that they are a metaphor for something that's missing inside of us.
ipa: /ˈɪz ˈɪz ðˈæt ðˈeɪ ˈɑɹ ə mˈɛtəfɔɹ fˈɔɹ sˈʌmθɪŋ ðˈæts mˈɪsɪŋ ˌɪnsˈaɪd ˈʌv ˈʌs/
